title.original: Which Agent Causes Task Failures and When? On Automated Failure Attribution of LLM Multi-Agent Systems
title.zh: 哪个代理导致任务失败以及何时失败？关于LLM多智能体系统的自动故障归因
title.en: Which Agent Causes Task Failures and When? On Automated Failure Attribution of LLM Multi-Agent Systems

inclusion_reason.zh: Who&When 将跨 Agent 日志、责任标注和自动归因器组成可复用诊断数据与评测基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: Who&When combines cross-agent logs, responsibility labels, and automated attributers into reusable diagnostic data and evaluation infrastructure.

abstract.zh: 该工作把多 Agent 任务失败归因定义为独立诊断问题，并以 Who&When 日志集研究“哪个 Agent、在哪一步”导致最终失败。
abstract.en: This work formulates multi-agent failure attribution as a distinct diagnostic problem and uses Who&When logs to identify which agent and which step caused a task failure.

problem.zh: 多 Agent 系统出错后，最终失败与上游责任 Agent、决定性错误步骤相隔很远，人工追溯成本高且难形成一致标签。
problem.en: After a multi-agent system fails, the responsible upstream agent and decisive step may be far from the final outcome, making manual tracing costly and inconsistent.

approach.zh: 作者收集多种 LLM 多 Agent 系统的失败日志，细粒度标注责任主体和步骤，并比较三类自动归因方法。
approach.en: The authors collect failure logs from diverse LLM multi-agent systems, annotate responsible agents and decisive steps, and compare three automated attribution methods.

system_design.zh: Who&When 流水线连接任务运行、跨 Agent 消息与工具轨迹、人工责任标签、候选归因器以及按 Agent/步骤拆分的评分。
system_design.en: The Who&When pipeline links task runs, cross-agent messages and tool traces, human responsibility labels, candidate attributers, and separate agent/step scoring.

key_results.zh: 最佳方法尚能一定程度定位责任 Agent，但决定性步骤识别远弱于主体识别，先进推理模型也未达到实用诊断水平。
key_results.en: The best method has some ability to locate the responsible agent, but decisive-step attribution is much weaker, and frontier reasoning models remain impractical diagnosticians.

limitations.zh: 归因标签依赖对单一责任链的人工判断，数据覆盖有限的系统与失败类型；共同诱因、延迟影响和多主体责任仍难表达。
limitations.en: Labels rely on human judgments of responsibility over a limited set of systems and failures; joint causes, delayed effects, and shared responsibility remain difficult to represent.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
